# RPLT USA

> RPLT USA is a curated catalog of lab tested research peptides for US researchers. Every listed peptide is 99% purity or higher and ships with a Certificate of Analysis. Orders are placed, processed and shipped by ProLongevity Peptides (https://prolongevitypeptide.com), the official store for the RPLT USA catalog. Free US shipping on orders over $150. All products are for laboratory research use only and are not for human consumption.

## Catalog

- [Research peptides catalog](https://rpltusa.com/peptides): All eleven peptides with live pricing and vial sizes.
- [Tirzepatide](https://rpltusa.com/peptides/tirzepatide): Dual GIP and GLP-1 receptor agonist for metabolic research.
- [Semaglutide](https://rpltusa.com/peptides/semaglutide): Long acting GLP-1 receptor agonist for metabolic research.
- [BPC-157](https://rpltusa.com/peptides/bpc-157): Body Protection Compound 157, studied in tissue repair research.
- [GHK-Cu](https://rpltusa.com/peptides/ghk-cu): Copper tripeptide for collagen and skin research.
- [Tesamorelin](https://rpltusa.com/peptides/tesamorelin): GHRH analog for body composition research.
- [TB-500](https://rpltusa.com/peptides/tb-500): Thymosin Beta-4 fragment for repair research.
- [CJC-1295 with DAC / Ipamorelin](https://rpltusa.com/peptides/cjc-1295-ipamorelin): GHRH analog paired with a selective GH secretagogue.
- [MOTS-c](https://rpltusa.com/peptides/mots-c): Mitochondrial derived peptide for metabolic and aging research.
- [AOD-9604](https://rpltusa.com/peptides/aod-9604): HGH fragment 177 to 191 for fat metabolism research.
- [Ipamorelin](https://rpltusa.com/peptides/ipamorelin): Selective growth hormone secretagogue.
- [Epithalon](https://rpltusa.com/peptides/epithalon): Tetrapeptide studied in longevity research.
